decisions.decision: The ATGV workspace must retain its existing .atgv contents while managing source checkouts in .atgv/src/extension and .atgv/src/library, and all sanitized extension/runtime error evidence in .atgv/src/error-logs.
The automatic coding agent reads .atgv/src/error-logs; delete only evidence verified as already reported on GitHub and preserve pending and submitted fix diagnostics.
